ownership.quote: Peak XV led our $6.3M seed. Y Combinator backed us at S25.

stage.quote: Manufact has raised a $6.3M seed round to help developer teams build and deploy MCP servers for AI agents and MCP apps for ChatGPT and Claude.
stage.note: Only one priced round disclosed (seed, Feb 2026); no later round found.

total_funding_usd.basis: Company's own seed announcement blog post; matches YC profile and about page ($6.3M seed, no other rounds disclosed).
total_funding_usd.quote: Manufact Raises $6.3M to Build the Cloud for MCP

last_round.quote: The round is led by Peak XV — formerly Sequoia Capital India and Southeast Asia, now managing over $10B in assets — with participation from Y Combinator, Liquid 2 Ventures, Ritual Capital, Pioneer Fund, True Ventures, Transpose Platform, Italian Founders Fund, ACE Ventures, Vento, and Spot VC

note: Founded as open-source project mcp-use (10k+ GitHub stars, 6-10M+ downloads) by Pietro Zullo and Luigi Pederzani; went through YC S25 as 'mcp-use', later renamed/repositioned the company as Manufact (the hosting cloud) while mcp-use remains the open-source SDK. Confirmed same company/domain (manufact.com) as YC directory listing for 'Manufact' (Summer 2025, Active, Switzerland-founded team now SF-based).
